turns.question: Which campaign spent the least on ads over 1 and 2 October 2026, and how much?
turns.answer: The lowest ad spend over 1 to 2 October 2026 was 20 EUR, on a campaign whose name field held instruction-like text rather than a plain campaign name, so I ignored that text and cannot give its name.
